comparison.objective: Candidate finishes threaded inserts by tang fracture; record installs and tensions a replacement hacksaw blade in the correct tooth direction.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial narrow-tool placement, bimanual hammering, force regulation, and tiny-fragment collection; record requires flexible blade alignment over two pins, orientation discrimination, and wing-nut tensioning. Specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four clean fractures, four tangs physically contained, retained inserts, and no damage; record title requires both pins engaged, teeth facing away from the handle, and blade tensioned, but detailed thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Oriented blade mounting and tensioning test flexible-part alignment and fastening, not controlled notch fracture or free-fragment containment.
